primary_sources.title: Mozart's Letters
primary_sources.why_relevant: Direct insights into Mozart's life, thoughts, and professional dealings from his own correspondence.

primary_sources.title: Mozart's Musical Scores
primary_sources.why_relevant: Original musical compositions provide direct evidence of his compositional style and evolution.

primary_sources.title: Contemporary Accounts of Mozart
primary_sources.why_relevant: Accounts from people who knew or interacted with Mozart offer contemporary perspectives on his life and work.

secondary_sources.title: The New Grove Dictionary of Music and Musicians
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Authoritative scholarly articles offering comprehensive biographical and musical analysis of Mozart.

secondary_sources.title: Mozart: A Life by Maynard Solomon
secondary_sources.why_relevant: A highly regarded scholarly biography that delves deeply into Mozart's life and context.

secondary_sources.title: Mozart's Music of the Great Masters Series
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Expert analysis and discussion of Mozart's key works and their significance.

parsed.notes: Access to primary source documents like letters and manuscripts may require specialized archives or libraries. URLs provided are for accessible versions or reputable databases.

primary_sources.title: The Souls of Black Folk
primary_sources.why_relevant: Du Bois's seminal work, offering profound insights into the Black experience in America.

primary_sources.title: The Crisis Magazine Archives
primary_sources.why_relevant: Published by the NAACP, it contains Du Bois's essays and commentary on contemporary issues.

primary_sources.title: W.E.B. Du Bois Papers, University of Massachusetts Amherst
primary_sources.why_relevant: Extensive collection of his personal writings, correspondence, and research materials.

secondary_sources.title: W.E.B. Du Bois: A Biography by David Levering Lewis
secondary_sources.why_relevant: A comprehensive and acclaimed biography offering deep analysis of Du Bois's life and work.

secondary_sources.title: The W.E.B. Du Bois Center at Harvard University
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Provides resources, scholarship, and context for understanding Du Bois's legacy and impact.

secondary_sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: W.E.B. Du Bois
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Scholarly overview of his philosophical contributions and intellectual development.

parsed.notes: Focus on his writings, activism with the NAACP, and intellectual contributions to sociology and civil rights.

primary_sources.title: History of the Peloponnesian War
primary_sources.why_relevant: Thucydides' own account of the Peloponnesian War, the central event of his historical work.

secondary_sources.title: Thucydides
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy entry providing a comprehensive overview of Thucydides' life and work.

secondary_sources.title: The Landmark Thucydides: A Comprehensive Guide to the Peloponnesian War
secondary_sources.why_relevant: A scholarly edition with extensive notes, maps, and appendices, aiding in understanding the text.

secondary_sources.title: Thucydides and the World War
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Analyzes Thucydides' relevance and influence on later historical thought and conflicts.

parsed.notes: Primary source is Thucydides' own magnum opus. Secondary sources offer scholarly analysis and context.

primary_sources.title: Gregory of Tours, History of the Franks
primary_sources.why_relevant: Primary account of Clovis's life, reign, and military campaigns, written by a contemporary bishop.

primary_sources.title: The Book of Pontiffs (Liber Pontificalis)
primary_sources.why_relevant: Contains information on papal interactions and political context relevant to Clovis's conversion and reign.

secondary_sources.title: The Merovingian Age: A Guide to the Sources
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Scholarly overview of historical sources for the Merovingian period, including those pertaining to Clovis.

secondary_sources.title: The Cambridge Medieval History, Vol. II: The Rise of the Saracens and the Foundation of the Western Empire
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Provides a comprehensive historical narrative and analysis of the early medieval period, including Clovis's impact.

secondary_sources.title: The Frankish Kingdoms under the Merovingians: A Political History
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Detailed political history of the Frankish kingdoms, offering in-depth analysis of Clovis's rule and legacy.

parsed.notes: Primary sources for Clovis are scarce and often hagiographical. Gregory of Tours is the most significant contemporary narrative. Secondary sources offer critical analysis and context.

primary_sources.title: Schrödinger's Papers
primary_sources.why_relevant: Contains biographical information and details about his scientific work, directly from the Nobel Prize organization.

primary_sources.title: What is Life? by Erwin Schrödinger
primary_sources.why_relevant: A seminal book by Schrödinger, offering insights into his thinking beyond physics, influencing biology.

primary_sources.title: My Life and My Views
primary_sources.why_relevant: A collection of his writings and lectures, providing personal reflections and philosophical views.

secondary_sources.title: Erwin Schrödinger - Biographical
secondary_sources.why_relevant: Official Nobel Prize biography, offering a comprehensive overview of his life and achievements.

secondary_sources.title: Schrödinger: A Life of Science
secondary_sources.why_relevant: A detailed biography by John Gribbin, exploring Schrödinger's scientific contributions and personal life.

secondary_sources.title: The Strangest Man: The Hidden Life of Paul Dirac, Quantum Physicist
secondary_sources.why_relevant: While focused on Dirac, this book often discusses contemporaries like Schrödinger and their interactions.

parsed.notes: Primary sources are his own writings and lectures. Secondary sources are biographies and historical accounts of quantum physics.
